formats.label: Deep dive
formats.definition: The standard Behind the Bastards story: the host tells the history of a person, organization, movement, event or practice, usually across one or more parts.

formats.label: Current affairs
formats.definition: An episode about events happening at or near the time of release, or an update on what a previously covered subject has done since.

formats.label: Reading / watching
formats.definition: The hosts read, watch or review a book, novel, manual, TV show or other media made by a bastard, and the episode is structured around that work.

formats.label: Hero episode
formats.definition: An episode explicitly about a good person or group: Christmas "non-bastard" and hero specials.

formats.label: Live show
formats.definition: An episode recorded in front of a live audience.

formats.label: Crossover / promo
formats.definition: An episode from, or promoting, another podcast, re-published in the BtB feed.

formats.label: Meta
formats.definition: Q&A, listener questions, year-end specials and other episodes about the show itself.

roles.label: Dictator / autocrat
roles.definition: Ruled a state without meaningful democratic constraint (including elected leaders who became autocrats).

roles.label: Monarch / royal
roles.definition: A king, emperor, tsar, kaiser, shah or prince, or a member of a royal family, whose royal status is central.

roles.label: Politician / official
roles.definition: Held or sought public office, elected or not: legislators, ministers, governors, mayors, diplomats and senior civil servants whose state role is the story.

roles.label: Political operative
roles.definition: Worked behind politicians as a strategist, fixer, lobbyist, lawyer or dirty-tricks specialist.

roles.label: Colonial figure
roles.definition: Ran, governed or profited from a colony as an official, company man or settler leader.

roles.label: Military officer / soldier
roles.definition: Served in a state armed force, and that service matters to the story.

roles.label: Mercenary / warlord
roles.definition: Led or fought in a non-state or private armed force.

roles.label: Police / lawman
roles.definition: Police officer, sheriff, prison official, border agent or police trainer.

roles.label: Spy / intelligence officer
roles.definition: Worked for an intelligence service or ran covert operations.

roles.label: Explorer / adventurer
roles.definition: Travelled to places unknown to their own society, led expeditions, or built a reputation on adventure.

roles.label: Scientist / scholar
roles.definition: Worked as a researcher, academic, archaeologist or naturalist (real credentials, whatever the ethics).

roles.label: Physician / surgeon
roles.definition: Licensed medical doctor or surgeon practising mainstream medicine.

roles.label: Psychiatrist / psychologist
roles.definition: Mental-health professional, therapist or self-styled psychology expert.

roles.label: Quack / fake healer
roles.definition: Sold treatments or cures without a scientific basis, with or without credentials.

roles.label: Inventor / engineer
roles.definition: Designed machines, weapons or technology, and the invention is central.

roles.label: Business owner / executive
roles.definition: Founded, owned or ran a non-tech business.

roles.label: Tech founder / executive
roles.definition: Founded or ran a technology or internet company.

roles.label: Financier / investor
roles.definition: Made their mark through finance, banking, speculation, crypto or investing.

roles.label: Con artist / grifter
roles.definition: Their main occupation was deceiving people for money or status.

roles.label: Religious leader / preacher
roles.definition: Clergy, preacher, televangelist or leader within an established religion.

roles.label: Cult leader
roles.definition: Founded or led a high-control group or new religious movement.

roles.label: Occultist / guru / spiritual teacher
roles.definition: Taught esoteric, occult, New Age or wellness spirituality outside an organized cult.

roles.label: Conspiracy theorist
roles.definition: Built a following by promoting conspiracy theories.

roles.label: Media personality / broadcaster
roles.definition: Radio, TV or podcast host or pundit.

roles.label: Journalist / propagandist
roles.definition: Worked in journalism, PR, advertising or state propaganda.

roles.label: Writer / intellectual
roles.definition: Author, philosopher or ideologue whose writing is their main influence.

roles.label: Entertainer / artist
roles.definition: Actor, director, musician, comedian, painter, cartoonist, fashion designer or other artist.

roles.label: Athlete / sports figure
roles.definition: Player, coach, team owner or sports official.

roles.label: Influencer / online figure
roles.definition: Built influence mainly through social media, forums or online video.

roles.label: Criminal / killer
roles.definition: Committed serious crimes (murder, trafficking, abuse, organized crime) as a central part of the story.

roles.label: Terrorist / militant
roles.definition: Carried out or organized political violence outside state forces.

roles.label: Activist / organizer
roles.definition: Organized a political or social movement, campaign or militia (bastard or hero).

themes.label: Science, archaeology & exploration
themes.definition: Expeditions, discovery, archaeology and scientific research as an enterprise.

themes.label: Occult, esoteric & New Age
themes.definition: Occultism, mysticism, Theosophy, astrology, psychics and New Age spirituality.

themes.label: Fraud & grift
themes.definition: Swindles, con jobs, scams, fake credentials and grifting.

themes.label: Corporate crimes
themes.definition: Companies or executives causing harm for profit: dangerous products, cover-ups, union-busting.

themes.label: Finance, real estate & crypto

themes.label: Labor & workers
themes.definition: Exploitation and killing of workers, strikes, labor disasters, union struggles.

themes.label: Environment & climate
themes.definition: Pollution, ecological destruction and climate denial.

themes.label: Weapons & arms dealing
themes.definition: Arms manufacturers, arms dealers, gun lobbies and weapons inventors.

themes.label: Racism & white supremacy
themes.definition: Racist movements, segregation, lynching and white-supremacist organizing.

themes.label: Misogyny & the manosphere

themes.label: Sexual abuse of adults

themes.label: Abuse of children
themes.definition: Any abuse of minors, sexual or not: child sexual abuse, troubled-teen facilities, residential schools, child prisons, baby trafficking, cruelty by parents or institutions.

themes.label: Propaganda & media
themes.definition: Propaganda, PR, news media, talk radio and manipulation of public opinion.

themes.label: Entertainment & celebrity
themes.definition: Hollywood, music, TV, fashion and celebrity culture.

themes.label: Sports
themes.definition: Athletes, teams, owners, sports bodies and competitions, including the Olympics and chess.

themes.label: Education & schools
themes.definition: Schools, universities, teachers, curricula and education movements, including for-profit and fake schools.

themes.label: Wellness & self-help
themes.definition: Self-help, fitness, diet, longevity and lifestyle gurus.

themes.label: Tech industry & the internet
themes.definition: Tech companies, online platforms, internet subcultures and Silicon Valley ideology.

themes.label: Artificial intelligence
themes.definition: AI companies, AI hype and harms caused by AI systems.

content_warnings.label: Sexual violence
content_warnings.definition: Detailed accounts of rape, sexual assault or sexual coercion of adults.

content_warnings.label: Child abuse
content_warnings.definition: Detailed accounts of physical, sexual or emotional abuse of children.

content_warnings.label: Graphic violence
content_warnings.definition: Explicit descriptions of killing, mutilation or injury.

content_warnings.label: Torture
content_warnings.definition: Detailed descriptions of torture or deliberate cruelty against captives.

content_warnings.label: Mass atrocity
content_warnings.definition: Detailed accounts of massacres, genocide or death camps.

content_warnings.label: Suicide & self-harm
content_warnings.definition: Discussion of a specific suicide, suicide method or self-harm.

content_warnings.label: Medical horror
content_warnings.definition: Graphic descriptions of surgery, experimentation on people or medical injury.

content_warnings.label: Animal cruelty
content_warnings.definition: Detailed descriptions of animals being harmed or killed.

content_warnings.label: Drug use & overdose
content_warnings.definition: Detailed accounts of drug use, addiction or fatal overdose.

content_warnings.label: Hateful language
content_warnings.definition: Extended reading or quoting of racist, antisemitic or other slurs and hate propaganda.

subject_kinds.label: Group of people
subject_kinds.definition: Two or more named people treated as one subject: a couple, a family, siblings, a gang or crew. List each person separately instead if the story treats them as distinct bastards.

subject_kinds.label: Organization
subject_kinds.definition: A formal body with a name and structure. Requires `org_type`.

subject_kinds.label: Movement or ideology
subject_kinds.definition: A diffuse movement, subculture or set of ideas without one controlling organization.

subject_kinds.label: Event
subject_kinds.definition: A bounded happening with a start and end: a disaster, war, coup, scandal, crime.

subject_kinds.label: Practice or pseudoscience
subject_kinds.definition: A method, treatment, technology or field (real or fake) whose history is the story.

subject_kinds.label: Place
subject_kinds.definition: A location whose history is the story itself.

subject_kinds.label: Media work
subject_kinds.definition: A book, show, film, magazine or game that is itself the subject.

org_types.label: Company
org_types.definition: A for-profit business, including family firms and conglomerates.

org_types.label: Government agency
org_types.definition: A civilian state body (FDA, Border Patrol, ICE). Use police / military / intelligence when those fit better.

org_types.label: Police
org_types.definition: Police forces, sheriffs' offices, police unions, prison and detention systems.

org_types.label: Military
org_types.definition: Armed forces, military units, mercenary companies.

org_types.label: Intelligence agency
org_types.definition: CIA, KGB, FBI (when the story is about its intelligence/covert role) and similar.

org_types.label: Religious body
org_types.definition: An established church, denomination or religious institution (Catholic Church, Southern Baptist Convention).

org_types.label: Cult or new religious movement
org_types.definition: A high-control group or new religion (Scientology, the Moonies, the 12 Tribes, Synanon).

org_types.label: School or facility
org_types.definition: A school, residential program, hospital, asylum, camp or troubled-teen facility.

org_types.label: Media outlet
org_types.definition: A newspaper, network, magazine, website or platform as an institution (Fox News, YouTube, 8chan).

org_types.label: Political organization
org_types.definition: A party, pressure group, militia, think tank or lobby (NRA, Proud Boys, John Birch Society).

org_types.label: Non-profit / NGO
org_types.definition: A charity, foundation or non-governmental organization.
